A pregnant tigress was moved from Bihar’s Valmiki Tiger Reserve to Bengal’s Buxa Tiger Reserve in a relocation marked by injuries, repeated escapes and the loss of three foetuses. Jay Mazoomdaar investigates how a VIP deadline, ignored protocols and gaps in forest management derailed an ambitious conservation plan.
